entries.1fa097b50232745b: It is an operational agency service that performs application acceptance, payment management, collection of overdue payments, removal of left-behind belongings and property patrols on behalf of self-storage operators. By paying a guarantee fee at signing, users do not need a guarantor or security deposit; if a user's payment is late, the company advances the amount and remits it to the operator, so operators can avoid the risk of uncollected usage fees.
entries.2e7753c3bfe9a55d: It is a service for operators of self-storage (rental storage space and trunk rooms); revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥1,458 million. It provides, together, business process outsourcing (BPO) with rent default guarantees and the development and operation of IT systems to improve operators' business efficiency, and as a reportable segment it consists of these two services.
entries.785771685e8ab95d: Investors and property owners considering investment in self-storage
entries.78e7c48b40b78cca: It is a service for operators of self-storage (rental storage space and trunk rooms); revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥1,458 million.
entries.851ae6bd24b01647: It is a service providing development and sale of self-storage facilities, business operation consulting, and master leasing (bulk leasing of buildings); revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥854 million.
entries.8a685ab13fd9d6a4: It is a service that provides a system allowing users to apply for, reserve and pay usage fees for self-storage via WEB, and the property inventory management system “Kurarisu” for operators.
entries.986f30cbb3837a76: Development and sale of self-storage facilities
entries.c2c563ec9eb3bb53: The company provides consulting on the operation of self-storage businesses and master leasing, in which it leases buildings in bulk, supporting new entrants in starting their businesses and in operating facilities.
entries.c9077dff1dd4fa1b: Business Solution (BPO with Rent Default Guarantee)
entries.dd6e4ffaa27f7e36: It is a service providing development and sale of self-storage facilities, business operation consulting, and master leasing (bulk leasing of buildings); revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended September 2025 was ¥854 million. For facilities such as those under the “Keep it” brand, through land acquisition and facility construction, renovation of existing buildings, real estate brokerage and renovation, and proposals for outdoor container-type facilities on leased land, it supports the creation of self-storage investment opportunities for operators and investors.
entries.de7c59cad7ff3016: Business start-up and operation support (consulting, master lease)
entries.e448ef56fe6e72fc: For self-storage facilities including those under the "Keep it" brand, the company develops and sells facilities in various ways: acquiring new land and constructing facilities, converting existing buildings into facilities, brokering real estate for renovation, and proposing outdoor container-type trunk room facilities on leased land.
entries.eb956c0dacbe9d9d: A company that provides self-storage operators such as trunk room businesses with operation outsourcing that includes rent default guarantees, reservation and inventory management systems, and the development and sale of facilities.
entries.f523b891c2492dba: It is an operational agency service that performs application acceptance, payment management, collection of overdue payments, removal of left-behind belongings and property patrols on behalf of self-storage operators.
entries.fb15451c0fafa6e6: It is a service that provides a system allowing users to apply for, reserve and pay usage fees for self-storage via WEB, and the property inventory management system “Kurarisu” for operators. It also provides “Kuragime,” which supports operators in attracting customers by distributing property information registered in “Kurarisu” through the portal site “Nikoniko Toranku.”
